verdict.rationale: ASA delivers each authorization as an HTTP POST from the ISO 8583 stream with a body that "includes transaction metadata". Auth Rules can key on MCC, country, currency and risk score, so MCC is clearly present in authorization context. The rest of the story's fields are not documented in the evidence: the digital-wallet mention refers to a separate tokenization stream, not wallet details carried on the authorization itself. Missing for 10: documented merchant name field, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details on auth events, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals, a full ASA payload schema, and any independent corroboration.
